Excise the DNA fragment from the agarose gel
Add 4 volumes of Gel Dissolving Buffer to the gel slice
Incubate the sample between 37–55°C (typically 50°C), until the gel slice is completely dissolved
Insert column into collection tube and load sample onto the column. Spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g, then discard flow-through
Re-insert column into collection tube. Add 200 l DNA Wash Buffer (with ethanol added) and spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g. Discarding flow-through is optional
Transfer column to a clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube. Use care to ensure that the tip of the column does not come into contact with the flow-through. If in doubt, re-spin for 1 minute
Add  6 l of DNA Elution Buffer to the center of the matrix. Wait for 1 minute, and spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g to elute the DNA
